meta.title: About
meta.description: arrange.work brings clients and specialists together, so good work can start sooner and run smoother.

hero.title: We make it simple to work with the right people
hero.text: arrange.work brings clients and specialists together, so good work can start sooner and run smoother.

mission.title: Why we're building arrange.work
mission.p1: Finding a reliable specialist often means hours of searching, endless messages and guessing who is actually right for the job. For specialists, finding clients who value their skills can be just as hard.
mission.p2: We're building one place where both sides can find each other, agree on clear terms and get the work done — without the noise.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Clear scope, rates and expectations from the very first message.

trust.title: Trust
trust.text: Honest profiles and open communication on both sides.

fairness.title: Fairness
fairness.text: A platform that works for clients and specialists alike.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.text: Fewer steps between an idea and a finished job.

stage.title: We're just getting started
stage.text: arrange.work is a young product that grows with the people who use it. Join early, tell us what you need and help shape how hiring specialists should work.
